$doc: Copy to config/pages.json in a buyer's clone. One entry per X page the buyer owns. voice, closing and disclaimer are required once a page is active, and every page writes its own closing and disclaimer (no shared sentence across pages).

pages.name: Example Page
voice: Health educator. Plain, specific, personally invested, never hypey.
Short sentences. Generous line breaks. One or two sentences per paragraph.
First person, low pressure. Reason before recommendation.
No em dashes. No fake urgency.
pages.closing:
Which of these will you try first?

Send it to someone who needs to read it.
